# Telegram Mini App SDK

`telegram-web-app.baa788a6f686.js` is an unchanged copy of the official Telegram SDK.

- Source: https://telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js
- Retrieved: 2026-11-18
- SHA-256: `baa788a6f686f4238db1b82ce8e76470930af7411b18b521ebb95a2c1480a267`

The filename contains the first 12 characters of the SHA-256 checksum. The script
is served from the application origin so startup does not depend on access to
`telegram.org`. Keep the script unchanged; project formatting rules apply to our
own code.

To update, download the official script, review its changes, calculate SHA-256,
replace the file using the new checksum in its name, and update the script URL in
`index.html` and this document. Run the browser checks before publishing. Updates
are reviewed manually; deployments do not download a fresh SDK automatically.
